method: Duration and five cached perceptual samples screened the corpus. All chronological sheets in both candidate pairs were inspected. Full-frame SSIM and compressed audio-packet SHA256 support the same-edit classification. Files are different encodes, not byte-identical. Other unrecognised duplicates remain possible.
